description.narrative: ?Improve education outcomes of school-aged children in the most vulnerable districts of Mozambique by using schools as platforms for integrated service delivery.

The operation aims to improve human development outcomes in Mozambique through integrated service delivery and climate-resilient infrastructure. It comprises four components: (1) An integrated package of HD services focusing on teacher training, social support for students, and school-based health services; (2) Climate-resilient and energy-efficient school infrastructure improvements to modernize basic schools and establish digital learning hubs; (3) Institutional strengthening to enhance service maintenance through improved school management and local capacity building; and (4) A Contingent Emergency Response Component for immediate crisis response. The project emphasizes cross-ministerial coordination, digital solutions, and climate resilience while incorporating Performance-Based Conditions to ensure effective implementation.
